sources.finding: Vendor distinguishes installed Correction from server Reformulation; Web agreements differ. Account/usage records and retention remain separate. No blanket no-account or no-telemetry conclusion.
Installed text-local claim is edition/feature specific. The statement about reformulated text not being stored/trained does not mean it is never transmitted.

Two documented automatic rewrite suggestion controls are enabled by default. Correction-state memory across sessions is also enabled by default; an application-wide clear function is documented. Exact storage representation and scope not established.

sources.finding: Favourites, customizations, settings and hidden alerts are separately selectable; initial choices follow onboarding response. New dictionary/rule-list automatic sync has a separate control. No universal default-off claim.

Global rewrite disabling removes feature UI; access-control options are initially off, so the disable switch must be enabled. Changing the panel requires local administrator credentials. Not an observed network block.
Rewrite uses vendor servers. Per-document disabling persists for that document while other documents remain enabled; it is not equivalent to the global disable switch.
Manual passive-construction review is documented. Sensitivity slider also relates to rewrite view; automatic rewrite is not required by the proposed manual review operation.
